content:
ops-bot: Deploy event: d-1798 started canary rollout v2.4.3 -> prod (5%)

support-eng: Multiple customers reporting 503/504s and timeouts since ~10:12 UTC. Billing jobs failing intermittently.

maria: I see a sharp 5xx spike from the api-gateway in us-west-2 for /v1/generate. Spike aligns with the canary window.

alex: That release included a selector change + the continuous_batching_v2 flag + kernelpath=v2-optimized. I pushed the selector at 10:08.

joel: Gateway logs sample: 'upstream reset while reading response header from upstream' and a bunch of dial tcp timeout entries.

ryan: Trying to reproduce locally against the canary tag.

joel: Repro curl: 
```
curl -H 'x-redwood-route: canary' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate\" \\n  -d '{"input":"hello world"}' \\n  --max-time 10
```

maria: Running that now with our canary token -> I get a 504 after ~10s, same as customer.

alex: Looking at routing metadata: canary selector accidentally matched route-shard tag instead of kernelpath, so some traffic got sent to nodes without the v2 kernel. Proto mismatch/timeouts are likely.

alex: I'm initiating an immediate rollback of the canary selector -> rolling back to stable selectors.

deploy-bot: Rollback started for d-1798 by alex. Rollback ID: rb-1798-1. Estimated ~2m for cutover.

support-eng: Notifying affected customers, adding credits and turning on higher verbosity in their tickets.

maria: 5xx rate down from 12% to ~2.1% within 90s of rollback. Traces show successful fallbacks kicking in.

joel: Quick mitigation idea: add a temporary routing fallback that pins canary traffic to model-legacy when gateway error rate > 5% — should we enable? :thinking:

alex: I can enable the fallback but prefer a fast rollback + validation gate in CI. Will run a gated canary later with the batching flag off.

sre-lead: Create an incident page, tag postmortem, and add a deploy guard to validate selector->kernel compatibility in CI. Also add a dashboard alert for selector mismatches.

product-tt: FYI PMs: a subset of customers reported duplicate billing traces while requests errored; support has given credits.

maria: Saving trace bundles and a minimal reproducer in S3: s3://redwood-incident/1798765433/traces.tgz and attaching to the incident.

support-eng: Ticket updated with workaround, customer notified, moving P1 -> monitoring.

alex: Leaving follow-up tasks in runbook: 1) CI selector validation, 2) canary test with kernel-compat checker, 3) postmortem doc.

sre-lead: Good job team. We'll sync in 30m and lock down rollout controls. :thumbsup:
